preText: 7:13pm The umpires make their way out to the middle, followed by the players. Sathvik will open the batting for the Tamizhans, alongside Raheja, who has been in stunning form. Warrier has the new ball for the Dragons. Can he make some early inroads? Let's find out! 7pm The captain winning the toss has, along expected lines, opted to bowl first. The Dragons held their own with the ball for much of yesterday, only for their death bowling to let them down slightly, Can they put together a more complete display tonight, against a side that scored 200 in Qualifier 1? Tiruppur Tamizhans XI: Amit Sathvik, Tushar Raheja (wk), Radhakrishnan, Balachander Anirudh, Mohamed Ali, S Ganesh, Sai Kishore (capt), P Bhuvaneswaran, Ajith Ram, Ramalingam Rohit, T Natarajan TT bench: Maan Bafna, M Mathivannan, M Karthik Saran, M Uday Kumar Dindigul Dragons XI: Vimal Khumar, Shivam Singh, Baba Indrajith (wk), Boopathi Kumar, S Dinesh Raj, R Ashwin (capt), Varun Charavarthy, Suboth Bhati, VP Diran, P Vignesh, Sandeep Warrier DD bench: Sarath Kumar, K Aashiq, K Om Nitin, G Kishoor 6:45pm Dindigul Dragons have won the toss and they have elected to field first. 6:40pm Each of the last three games at the TNPL have been won by the chasing side, and today we are at a new venue, with no precedent from this season on what conditions await. Will that make it a no-brainer for the captain winning the toss to bowl first? We will find out soon. 6:25pm Dindigul Dragons have had the wood over the Tamizhans, and have won each of their last five matches against them. Will that run continue tonight, or will the Tamizhans break that rut? 6:15pm Dindigul Dragons versus the Tiruppur Tamizhans. Two teams that finished on eight points after the league stages. Two sides led by ace spinners (who also double up as all-rounders). Two franchises yet to win the Tamil Nadu Premier League. And two outfits that are chomping at the bit to contest the game that matters in two days' time. The Dragons, because they won their last game, might feel they have the momentum, even though they made heavy weather of a run-chase that seemed routine at one point. The Tamizhans, on the other hand, were chastened by the defending champions in Qualifier 1 but will believe that they can turn things around quickly, especially now that they have been given another opportunity to make the final. Both teams, of course, will want much more than just getting to the final and making up the numbers. But to entertain those thoughts and to continue that narrative, they simply must to win tonight. Hello and welcome to ESPNcricinfo's live coverage of the TNPL. This, folks, is Qualifier 2. The luxury of erring no longer exists now. It didn't for the Dragons anyway on Wednesday, and now, the Tamizhans are in the same boat, knowing that one misstep, one miscalculation and a promising campaign could fall apart. Both of these teams, though, will also know that one moment of magic, of character, of grit or genius, and they will get to where they want to be: up against the Kovai Kings, with the TNPL title on the line. Hop on, this should be fun!
